avis.titre: Lightweight, But the White Cast Was a Dealbreaker
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this sunscreen, but it just wasn't the right fit for me. I have a medium-tan complexion with olive undertones, and it left a noticeable white cast that was very difficult to blend out—even after spending extra time rubbing it in. Unfortunately, the white cast never fully disappeared and made my skin look ashy. If you have a similar complexion or are sensitive to sunscreens that leave a white cast, this is something to keep in mind. I won't be repurchasing it.

avis.titre: I would not use this product for safety concern
avis.texte: I want to make other consumers aware that this product contains 15% homosalate — double the 7.34% concentration limit now allowed under updated EU cosmetic safety regulations. Homosalate is a chemical UV filter that has raised safety concerns due to potential hormone-disrupting effects at higher concentrations. If you're mindful about sunscreen ingredients or follow EU standards for cosmetic safety, this is something to pay attention to before purchasing or using this product.

avis.titre: Great Protection, but Slight White Cast
avis.texte: The Shiseido Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen offers excellent sun protection with a lightweight, mattifying formula that works wonderfully for my combination skin. However, the only drawback is the slight white cast it leaves behind, especially on deeper skin tones or when I apply generously. While it's not a dealbreaker for me, I do have to take extra time to blend it out fully. Overall, it's a high-quality sunscreen with great performance, but a little improvement in the cast would make it perfect. Gifted by Shiseido

avis.titre: Follow Up to Review Left Several Days Ago, Exp Date?
